description: A detailed report over a date range. name = income | revenue-by-act | average-booking | appearances | conversion | repeat | mileage | business-history. from/to = YYYY-MM-DD (default this year). mileage = one-way + round-trip driving miles from the home base to each gig (tax mileage); distances are cached per date, lookups caps fresh Google lookups per call (default 50) and rows with status=pending fill on the next call. business-history = the whole life of the business, one row per year (ignores from/to): performed that year by gig date (total fees, bookings, gigs, averages, year-over-year change), booked that year by booking date, booking balance (booked − performed) and the running 'on the books' total; status is complete | so_far (the current year) | booked_ahead (future years with gigs). Lost bookings are left out unless include_lost=true.

from.description: The sender — an email address or phone number, per the tool.

name.description: A name (person or company, depending on the tool).

to.description: The recipient — an email address or phone number, per the tool.
